summary: Created the customer-feedback-form test-design artifact with 77 traceable test cases covering all planned stories and failure paths: public link resolution, 30-day expiry, public form display, server-side rating/message validation, existing feedback record update, read-only repeat-submission display, and restricted non-browser verification. Evidence reviewed included the customer feedback form requirements, prior batch-upload test design, Prisma Feedback model, feedback request email link contract, and batch creation service. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact were not run per task constraints.
